title: Wildlife Insights Detection Weekly Clip Length Trend
dataSources: BirdNET detections (`birdnet:detection`), trail-cam detections (`trailcam:detection`), moth-trap captures (`mothtrap:capture`), bat-detector passes (`batdetector:pass`), pollinator counts (`pollinator:count`), wildlife-cam visits (`wildlifecam:visit`).
app: Backyard wildlife monitoring — BirdNET acoustic bird ID, trail cameras with object detection, camera moth traps, ultrasonic bat detectors, and pollinator counts — via MQTT and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=wildlifeinsights:detection clip_sec=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(clip_sec) as avg_duration, max(clip_sec) as worst_duration by _time
| sort _time
description: Trends the average and worst clip length for Wildlife Insights detection events each week.
value: Weekly timing trends show whether a process is becoming slower, more erratic, or healthier over time.
implementation: Capture clip_sec on each event and review weekly averages plus worst cases during your personal ops review.
visualization: Line chart of weekly average clip length with markers for the worst week.
grandmaExplanation: It estimates whether Wildlife Insights detection tasks are taking longer than they used to and where the slow weeks were.
